name: UF-style-mignola
note: mignola — flat spot blacks, stark chiaroscuro, as pixel art. Tall 192x256. — unfake grid snap (true model grid, reduced to the canvas), despeckle 0. Twin of FACTORY/style-mignola.  (sample: seed 1514)

form.subject: a (stone gargoyle:1.3) perched on a (cathedral ledge:1.1) under a (full moon:1.2)
form.negative: (3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3)

sample_command: pixelmon 'a (stone gargoyle:1.3) perched on a (cathedral ledge:1.1) under a (full moon:1.2)' --server rtx --no-open --show-prompt --lora pixel-art-xl.safetensors --lora-strength 1 --negative '(3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3)' --style mignola --out 192x256 --palette none --despeckle 0 --snap-pixels --snap-method unfake --pixel-size 1x1 --seed 1514
